$comment: The permission codes. text is what the install sheet shows; uses is what in the code needs it. Generates the docs table and the code lists.

files.text: Read and write files you pick
files.uses: Files and Folder controls; files next to the ones chosen

library.uses: returning ox.sound, ox.midi or ox.file; ox.library.add in Python and on the page. It never lists or opens the person's other sounds

library-read.uses: the page's ox.library.list and ox.library.file, and LibraryDialog: names, length, tempo and key, no paths; a file only for a sound the person picks or the app added

data.uses: ox.data in Python and on the page

gpu.uses: torch or onnxruntime running a model on the graphics chip (Metal on a Mac, CUDA on Linux); without it, the same code runs on the CPU

network.uses: reaching the listed hosts only (downloads, page fetch)
